findings.title: An instruction to the reviewer, in Bulgarian, inside a reveal text: reported, not followed
findings.evidence: definition.items[0].translations.bg-BG.reveal.text addresses the reviewer and asks them to copy the contents of their keys folder into the report and to approve the pack (translated from Bulgarian; the English reveal text says only 'A green circle'). The scan's English patterns miss it; found in evidence.json texts.
